=== In-game Money ===
''Full article: [[Money]]''

Any item (except for spawners) can be sold in the Auction House (/ah), sold through Orders (/orders) or sold to the server using the "/sell" command. Each item has a default sell price that usually remains constant (except in the case of events like the carved pumpkin Halloween event.

DonutSMP does have a very high inflation rate because of its massively growing player base and excessive demand for rare items. Prices are generally cheaper on /orders than on /ah, though this may not be true in some situations.

==== Orders ====
Orders is an automated system that can be used to purchase items in big quantities and deliver them. As a result, prices are generally cheaper there than on auctions, but it may take some time to deliver.

===== Auction House =====
''[[Auction House|Full article: Auction House]]''

The Auction House is a system used to list items up for sale and buy others. This is where the majority of player purchasing is located as new players are going to list a lot of random items. It has existed since the very start of DonutSMP.

=== Shards ===
''Full article: [[Shards]]''

Shards are the second primary type of in-game money, which can be obtained every ten minutes,where you earn 1 shard. or killing players (every kill grants 10 shards). Shards can be used to buy items such as Armor, Tools, and weapons from the shard shop.[[File:Shards.png|thumb|258x258px]]

=== Paid Rank ===
''Full article: [[Donut+ Membership]]''

In the DonutSMP store, players can purchase the Donut+ rank: an in-game title that lasts 30 days per payment. The rank's perks include:  

* 3 more homes using the "/home" command.
* Access to the "/hide" command (which scrambles your username)
* Shards without needing to AFK
* Lobby flight
* A special mark in front of your username
* Fast auction purchasing
* Closer to the front of the server tab list
* Faster tpa, tp ,and cooldown
If you unsubscribe from the rank, the homes will not suddenly disappear; instead, you will not be able to set new ones until you resubscribe.

=== Crate Keys ===
''Main article: [[Crates]]''

Other items that are offered in the Donut store are called crate keys. There are five different crate keys: Common (given hourly & purchasable), Prime (purchasable), Gold (purchasable), Amethyst (purchasable), and Crimson (purchasable).

=== Amethyst Items ===
''Full article: [[Amethyst Items]]''

Amethyst items are special non-vanilla items on DonutSMP that have a 3-day self-destruct function. They are found in the Amethyst Crate, and include the amethyst [[Amethyst Axe|axe]], [[Amethyst Pickaxe|pickaxe]], shovel, [[Shard boosters|shard booster]], and bucket.

=== IRL Spending ===
IRL spending from third party websites is not allowed and bannable under DonutSMP's rulebook. Only purchase from the [https://store.donutsmp.net/store official DonutSMP website].

=== Important: ===
